sections.heading: Model identity and source scope
sections.source_text: Galaxy S20 Ultra 5G · Galaxy S20 Ultra Specifications

sections.heading: Display
sections.source_text: - Display: 6.9-inch Quad HD+ Dynamic AMOLED 2X | Infinity-O Display (3200X1440) | HDR10+ certified | 120Hz display support

sections.heading: Camera
sections.source_text:
- Rear camera: Quad camera | - Ultra Wide: *12MP, F2.2(120˚) | - Wide-angle: *108MP, F1.8(79˚), PDAF, OIS | - Telephoto: **48MP, PDAF, F3.5(24˚), OIS | - DepthVision | * Super Resolution Zoom includes digital zoom, which may cause some image deterioration. | ** 48MP for zooming only.
- Front camera: 40MP, PDAF, F2.2(80˚)

sections.heading: Dimensions
sections.source_text: - Body: 76.0 x 166.9 x 8.8mm, 220g | * 5G mmWave version weighs 222g.

sections.heading: Processor
sections.source_text: - AP: - 7㎚ 64-bit Octa-Core Processor *2.7 GHz (Maximum Clock Speed) + 2.5 GHz + 2 GHz | - 7㎚ 64-bit Octa-Core Processor *2.8 GHz (Maximum Clock Speed) + 2.4 GHz + 1.8 GHz | * May differ by market and carrier.

sections.heading: Storage and memory
sections.source_text:
- Memory: 5G/LTE | 16GB RAM (LPDDR5) with 512GB internal storage | 12GB RAM (LPDDR5) with 128/256GB internal storage |
- Expandable Memory & SIM: Single SIM model: one Nano SIM and one MicroSD slot (up to 1TB) | Dual SIM model (Hybrid SIM slot): one Nano SIM and one Nano SIM or one MicroSD slot (up to 1TB) | * SIM card sold separately. Availability of Dual SIM may vary depending on country and carrier. | * MicroSD card sold separately. Availability may vary depending on country and manufacturer. | * eSIM supported on Galaxy S20, S20+, S20 Ultra models. eSIM requires a wireless service plan and allows you to activate a mobile network plan without the use of a nano-SIM. eSIM availability may vary depending on country and carrier. Check with your carrier if your mobile network plan supports eSIM.

sections.heading: Connectivity
sections.source_text:
- Network: 5G**: 5G Non-Standalone (NSA), 5G Standalone (SA), Sub6 / mmWave, Dynamic Spectrum Sharing (DSS)
- Connectivity: Wi-Fi | Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax 2.4G+5GHz, HE80, MIMO, 1024-QAM | Up to 1.2Gbps Download / Up to 1.2Gbps Upload | Bluetooth | Bluetooth® v 5.0 , ANT+, USB type-C, NFC, Location (GPS, Galileo, Glonass, BeiDou) | * Galileo and BeiDou coverage may be limited. BeiDou may not be available for certain countries.
